multi_chunk_policy: All overlapping chunks are retained; coverage_status records whether their clipped union fully covers the gold span.
predicate: same document_id and chapter_id, and max(gold.char_start, chunk.char_start) < min(gold.char_end, chunk.char_end)
relevant_chunk_unit: A retrieved chunk is relevant to one gold span exactly when its chunk_id appears in that span's matching_chunk_ids.
role_policy: M3 core OR-of-AND membership and partial-evidence membership are copied as source_metadata and are never inferred or modified by M4.
